covers.what: Recovery: register (context, model_select, before_agent_start, session_start, session_shutdown handlers), messageEnd, cancel, hibernate, turnEnd, beforeSettle, command (cancel), restoreIdleWait
TransientBackoff: resume, reset, cancel, skip, waiting, messageEnd, turnEnd, handedToIdle, consumeReady, localWaitEnded, seedOutage
LocalIdleWait: start, restore, yieldToRun, cancel, skip, stop, run; openWait

checks.name: faithful
checks.why: Pi and the code as they are. A resume comes for a failure that nothing owes (F1, F2).

checks.name: faithful-one-wait
checks.why: Two waits at once: the idle wait of a failure goes on while the same run continues and its next request starts an in-run wait (F2).

checks.name: faithful-open-entry
checks.why: An open local-wait entry with no wait behind it (F1: /clone copies it).

checks.name: f1-clone-reload
checks.why: Assume the F2 fix: a /clone during an idle wait, then /reload in the clone, starts a run on its own (F1).

checks.name: f2-run-continues
checks.why: Assume the F1 fix: a message that steers into the failing run continues it, and the idle wait still resumes later (F2).

checks.name: f2-run-continues-one-wait
checks.why: Assume the F1 fix: the continued run fails again with a short rate limit while the idle wait goes on (F2).

checks.name: f2-no-steer
checks.why: Assume the F1 fix, and no message steers into a run: another extension's agent_before_settle continue alone gives F2.

checks.name: f3-late-return
checks.why: F1, F2 and F4 fixed: the user leaves the session during the idle wait and comes back after the 10 min restart limit. session_start(resume) refuses the restore but leaves the entry open, and a later /reload restores it (F3, found by the step-9 review).

checks.name: f4-tree-away
checks.why: F1, F2 and F3 fixed: /tree while idle goes to a point before the failure, but the idle wait goes on and resumes a task that is not on the branch (F4, found by the step-9 review).

checks.name: f5-tree-back-reload
checks.why: All fixes on, with the /tree fix in a session_tree handler (TREE_ENDS_IDLE_WAIT): /tree away writes the closed entry on the new branch, /tree back finds the old branch's open entry, and a /reload restores it (F5, found by the round-2 review).

checks.name: f6-close-before-move
checks.why: All fixes on, with the /tree fix in a session_before_tree handler (TREE_CLOSES_BEFORE_MOVE): its closed entry is a child of the old leaf, so /tree away and back to the old leaf finds the open entry, and a /reload restores it (F6, found by the round-3 review).

checks.name: assume-fix
checks.why: Both fixes: a new request ends the idle wait, and a fork closes a copied open entry. The /tree fix ends the wait and closes a stale open entry when the user arrives on a branch (TREE_CLOSES_ON_ARRIVAL).

checks.name: assume-fix-wide
checks.why: The same with 4 requests and 3 inputs. One navigation only, to keep the state space in reach.

checks.name: assume-fix-no-other-continue
checks.why: The same with no other extension that continues at agent_before_settle.

checks.name: survivor-transient-wait-ignores-abort
checks.why: transient.ts:390 without the `runSignal.aborted` check before the wait. The wait then runs after an Esc, but the check after it (transient.ts:423) and the end of the aborted run (AS:1440-1457: no agent_before_settle after an abort) keep it from resuming, and the next run clears its ready flag. The wasted wait breaks no property. The conformance replay catches this change.
